title: About
heading: A little about me.
subheading: Psychotherapist. Trauma specialist. Believer in the body's capacity to heal.
name: Xiuyun (Sharon) Miao, LCSW
body: I'm a Licensed Clinical Social Worker in New York City specializing in trauma, PTSD, anxiety, and grief. My work draws from EMDR, Internal Family Systems (IFS), and somatic approaches — modalities that work with the whole person, not just the presenting problem.
secondary: I believe healing happens in relationship. My role is to offer a space that is safe, unhurried, and genuinely attuned — where you can begin to understand yourself more deeply and move toward the life you want.
philosophy: Trauma is not a life sentence. It is a wound — and wounds, given the right conditions, can heal. My work is grounded in the conviction that every person, no matter what they've been through, carries within them the capacity for recovery.
I work slowly and carefully, following your nervous system's lead. There is no rushing here, no agenda to push through. We go at the pace that feels safe — and we adjust as we go.
I also believe that the therapeutic relationship itself is healing. The experience of being truly seen, heard, and held — without judgment — is often the most transformative part of the work.
